newsitem.title: USA: Ramirez & Co opens new muni office in Houston.
newsitem.headline: Ramirez & Co opens new muni office in Houston.

text.p: Samuel A. Ramirez & Co said Monday it opened a new public finance office in Houston, the company's fifth location, and hired J. Art Morales from Estrada Hinojosa & Co to run it.

"Opening a public finance office in Houston is part of our on-going strategy to strenthen our firm's national presence for new issue municipal securities," said George Graham, a New York-based managing director, in prepared remarks.

The firm, set up in 1972 as a retail brokerage for municipal bonds and fixed-income securities, said it has since expanded to serve both institutional and retail accounts, and specializes in municipal securities.
On a nationwide basis, Samuel A. Ramirez said it ranks among the top 12 companies in the industry when measured by total dollar volume and the total number of co-managed, regional deals.
